summary: Multi-Currency Engine feature testing completed successfully. All 19 backend tests passed and all frontend features verified working correctly.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

seed_data_creation: Database seeded with 155 currencies and 198 countries. Two test companies exist: 'Test Company UK' (GBP) and 'US Division' (USD)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-currency engine fully implemented and tested. Reference APIs (/api/reference/currencies, /api/reference/countries) return seeded data. Transaction model has transaction_currency and reporting_currency fields that auto-populate from company. Frontend CurrencyContext provides formatCurrency and getSymbol functions. Company selector in header updates currency symbols throughout dashboard.

backend: GET /api/reference/currencies - Returns 155 currencies with code, name, symbol, decimal_places
GET /api/reference/countries - Returns 198 countries with country, code, region, default_currency
GET /api/reference/currency/{code} - Returns single currency by ISO code
GET /api/reference/regions - Returns list of regions (APAC, EMEA, Americas)
POST /api/companies - Supports country_code, global_region, reporting_currency fields
POST /api/transactions - Auto-populates transaction_currency and reporting_currency from company
Transaction model - Has transaction_currency, reporting_currency, reporting_amount, fx_rate fields
Same currency transactions - fx_rate=1.0 and reporting_amount=amount
frontend: Add Company dialog - Searchable country dropdown with 198 countries
Add Company dialog - Searchable currency dropdown with 155 currencies
Country selection - Auto-populates default currency and region
Company list - Shows currency symbol (£, $, €, ¥) based on company currency
CFO Command Center - Shows correct currency symbol based on selected company
Company selector - Switching companies updates currency symbols throughout dashboard
